title: claim calls coord inside the claims-ledger lock, so a slow served coord can hold the lock past its 60 s stale age
goal: claim takes the item's run state from coord outside the claims-ledger lock, or bounds that call below LEDGER_LOCK_STALE_S, so a slow coord never lets a waiting claim clear a live lock

run:
import sys
sys.path.insert(0,'_tools')
import bl_base, bl_clean
assert bl_clean.COORD_SECONDS < bl_base.LEDGER_LOCK_STALE_S, ('a coord call inside the ledger lock can outlast its stale age', bl_clean.COORD_SECONDS, bl_base.LEDGER_LOCK_STALE_S)

notes: Review G3: bl_items.py:376 calls take_claim inside ledger_lock; COORD_SECONDS 60 (bl_clean.py:104) equals LEDGER_LOCK_STALE_S 60 (bl_base.py:693). The repro reads the bound only; moving the call out of the lock also fixes it.
